download_artifact_to_file: download a cached artifact by name to a specified destination file on the filesystem
upload_artifact_from_file: upload a file to the artifact cache under a given name for later retrieval
create_cache_instance: create an artifact cache instance that can be monkey patched with a real implementation
review_ArtifactCache_class: review the ArtifactCache class and its download and upload methods for CI build caching
refactor_create_cache: refactor the create_cache function to return a concrete ArtifactCache implementation instead of None
